title: Downtown City MegaKit (Standard)
author: Quaternius
notes: source/ is the Standard package's glTF export as downloaded (gltf + bin). Its PNGs were moved to textures/, the only other change.
source/ carries a .gdignore: Godot imports the normalised pieces/, never the raw files.

The kit is authored on a 2 m plan module and a 3 m storey (a 1 m band piece makes a 4 m storey). Walls span x -1..1, y 0..3, with the exterior face at z = 0 facing +Z and the interior face at z = -0.2.

module_scale is baked into every piece's vertices by tools/building_kit/normalize_kit.py. 0.91 puts the 2 m module on the Japanese ken (1.82 m), a storey at 2.73 m, a banded storey at 3.64 m and the door openings at 2.0 m. Change it here and rebuild; nothing else holds the number.
rows_notes: A ROW is one storey of one side: `pieces` cycle along the side's modules (2 m source pieces only), `band` stacks a 1 m piece on top (a 3 + 1 m storey), `door` replaces the module(s) a type puts a door on, `corner` stands at each end of the side, `rail` is laid at the storey's base on the outside.
door_opening is the walk-through hole of every `door` piece in SOURCE metres (half width, height), measured on the pieces' own triangles; collision leaves exactly that gap.

party_wall_row: the row an `attached` side uses on every storey (a blank party wall), `banded` for a storey whose open sides carry a band. stair_house: the row and footprint (modules) of the 塔屋 on a flat roof over three storeys.
